title: Token Granularity Attribution Bridge: end-to-end per-token cost & cache-impact telemetry
creator: Asha Patel
description:
Goal: Build an end-to-end telemetry bridge that attributes inference cost and latency down to token granularity, and surfaces KV-cache (prefix/KV) delta impact on per-token latency and downstream cost metrics. This ticket implements the runtime hooks, trace/span conventions, metric names, log schema, aggregation pipeline changes, and dashboards needed for product teams to answer: "Which tokens, positions, and cache interactions drive tail latency and unit cost?"

Scope and approach:
- Instrumentation hooks: add lightweight micro-timers at the following micro-stages: input-parse, batching-wait, kv-lookup-start, kv-lookup-end, kernel-exec-start, kernel-exec-end, token-emit. Each token will be associated with an ordered token_index and token_source (cache|model|fallback). Tokens emitted by streaming will get an additional stream_flush timer.
- Trace/span model: introduce a TokenSpan (kind=internal) with attributes {token_index, token_text_hash, token_source, model_variant, batch_id, request_id}. TokenSpan parent is the request span; kernel and kv lookup sub-spans will be children of TokenSpan where possible to enable 'span stitching' across async batched execution. Sampling: 100% capture of error-containing requests, 5% capture for success requests by default (configurable per-customer).
- Metric and log schema: Prometheus metrics for aggregation and dashboards, and structured logs for eventual offline joins. Key metrics: rwi_token_latency_ms, rwi_token_kv_hit_rate, rwi_token_cpu_ms, rwi_token_gpu_ms, rwi_token_cost_units. Log fields for token events: {timestamp_iso, request_id, token_index, token_source, token_hash, stage, duration_ms, batch_size, model_variant, region, instance_type}. Use JSONL in Loki for detailed events; counters/gauges in Prometheus/Pushgateway for high-cardinality rollups.
- Aggregation pipeline: route token events to Kafka topic rwi.token-events. Stream job (Flink) will produce two outputs: high-cardinality sampled traces -> tracing cluster (Jaeger/OTLP); and aggregated rollups (1m/1h) keyed by model_variant, route, token_position_bucket -> Prometheus remote_write/long-term metrics store.
- Console/Alerts: Add Token Cost Explorer dashboard (by model_variant, token_position, cache-hit vs miss), Cache Impact Heatmap (cache hit ratio vs token latency at percentiles), and Token Tail Latency Alert (p95 token latency increases >15% over baseline for 30m).

Design trade-offs / constraints:
- We avoid emitting full token_text to tracing/logs to protect PII; instead we store token_text_hash and allow ops to request safe rehydration under strict audit controls.
- High cardinality: per-token traces are expensive; we use sampling + aggregation to limit cost. Full traces reserved for errors and manual sampling windows.
- Backwards compatibility: telemetry fields are additive; older agents will not break dashboards but will be marked as partial in rollups.

Acceptance criteria (must be demoed in staging):
1) Runtime emits TokenSpan for every token in sampled traces and produces structured token events to rwi.token-events in Kafka.
2) Aggregation job produces 1m rollups with keys: {model_variant, route, token_position_bucket, cache_hit:boolean} and these metrics are visible in Prometheus metrics store.
3) Console shows Token Cost Explorer with ability to filter by model_variant and toggle cache-hit vs miss impact; sample queries return under 5s.
4) Alerts fire in staging for injected latency regressions (test harness simulates KV slowdowns).
5) Docs (Confluence) describing trace format, metric names, and retention are published and linked.

Migration and rollout plan:
- Phase 1 (canary, 1 week): Deploy runtime hooks to canary fleet with sampling 10% and aggregation enabled. Observe pipeline throughput and Kafka partitioning.
- Phase 2 (staged expansion, 2 weeks): Expand sampling to 1% across regions; validate rollups and dashboard queries.
- Phase 3 (GA): Default sampling 0.05% for successes, 100% for errors. Enable dashboards for PM/Eng roles.

Runbook notes:
- If Kafka lag increases > 2h, reduce sample rate immediately and route only error traces.
- If Prometheus remote_write failures occur, fall back to in-cluster retention and mark metrics as degraded in Console.

Open questions / next steps:
- Decide persistent identifiers for token_hash rehydration and who can request de-hashed tokens (security/Legal input needed).
- Finalize the token_position bucketing strategy (per-position up to 64 then logarithmic buckets).
- Cost estimate for storage over next quarter (ops to provide).
